questions.question_text: Āpaṇe jyāre tan-man-dhan Bhagwānne arpaṇ karyu tyāre have Bhagwānnī ......... te ja āpaṇu prārabdha chhe.
questions.explanation: When we offer our body, mind, and wealth to Bhagwān, then His wish is our destiny.

questions.question_text: Bhagwān āpaṇne hāthīe besāḍe to hāthīe besīne rājī rahevu ane .......... besāḍe to gadheḍe besīne rājī rahevu.
questions.explanation: If Bhagwān seats us on an elephant, we should remain happy sitting on the elephant; and if He seats us on a donkey, we should remain happy sitting on the donkey.

questions.question_text: Pote potānā sukhne bhogavto nathī ne pote potānā rūpne jāṇto nathī, e ja sarva agnānīmā .......... agnānī chhe.
questions.explanation: He who does not enjoy his own bliss and does not know his own form is the most ignorant amongst all ignorant people.

questions.question_text: Antarmā ṭāḍhu rahyā kare ne dhagī na jāy tenā be upāy chhe: ek to Bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju Bhagwānne .......... samajvā.
questions.explanation: There are two ways to remain calm within and not be agitated: one is to do bhajan of Bhagwān, and the other is to understand Bhagwān to be the all-doer.
Your māyā is extremely powerful; it has enveloped men and women.

questions.question_text: Mārī māyāmā nahi mūnjhāo, .......... nahi bandhāo.
questions.explanation: Do not be confused by my māyā; do not be bound by the body, etc.

questions.question_text: Moṭā moṭā Bhagwānnā bhakta temṇe paṇ Bhagwān pāse em ja māgyu chhe je, Aham-mamatvarūp māyā thakī rakshā karjyo ane .......... viṣhe prīti thajyo.
questions.explanation: Even the great devotees of Bhagwān have prayed to Bhagwān, “Protect us from māyā, which is in the form of aham and mamatva, and may we have love for You.”

questions.question_text: Antarmā bhajan karvā shīkhvu, teṇe karīne .......... rāg ochhā thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: Learn to do bhajan within; by doing so, the attachment to sensual pleasures decreases.

questions.question_text: Mān-apamānmā potāne .......... mānavu je, āpaṇāthī koī moṭo nathī, māṭe kenī pāse mān-apamān mānavu?
questions.explanation: In honor and insult, consider oneself to be Akshar, that no one is greater than us; therefore, from whom should we expect honor and insult?

questions.question_text: Māṭe baḷ Mahārājnu, rākhvu ..........; Teh vinā aparādh ṭāḷvā, anya nathī upāy.
questions.explanation: Therefore, keep the strength of Mahārāj in your heart; there is no other way to remove offenses without it.
